A light horn warning may help when a pedestrian or bicyclist enters your lane, another driver moves into it, or a backing driver has not noticed your approach. Stopping distance includes travel from recognizing a need to stop until the vehicle becomes stationary under the stated ideal conditions. A higher traveling speed requires additional stopping time and distance.
